profile.headline: Building for the modern web | Frontend-focused software developer and owner at Cosite | Using React, TypeScript, and Headless CMSs
profile.summary:
👋 Hi, I'm Alyssa.

I am passionate about frontend development and great design. I've been making websites for over a decade. During that time, I've worked for multiple agencies, I've worked directly with my own clients, and I've also worked as an in-house engineer at several companies including Curology and Epic Healthcare. I am currently building Cosite, a frontend development partner for technology companies.

We building headless marketing websites, scalable landing page systems, and web apps. Let us take frontend development off your team's hands today!

positions.title: Owner | Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
A software development partner for technology companies. We turn your website into a scalable marketing engine.

Clients include: Curology, Agency Skincare, The New York Times, and more.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Headless · React.js · Next.js · Sanity

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on rd.nytimes.com redesign/support, developed Wordle and Connections games for VR headset, and integrated AI technologies into products.

positions.title: Visiting Faculty
positions.description:
Visiting faculty for Miami University's Emerging Technology in Business + Design department.

I teach a web design and development course sequence where students learn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I rewrote the course to use a lab-based approach and industry-standard tooling like GitHub, Visual Studio Code, and Figma to better prepare students for post-graduation work experience.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · GitHub · Teaching · JavaScript · Figma (Software)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed curology.com and withagency.com scalable landing page systems.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer, Site
positions.description: My team at Curology is in charge of curology.com and withagency.com. We collaborate with cross-functional teams like marketing and design to create new pages and features for these sites.

positions.title: Freelance Developer and Designer
positions.description: As a freelance web developer, I provide web design, web development, and SEO services to small business, startups, and entrepreneurs. My preferred tech is React-based static site generators like Gatsby and Next.js and headless CMSs like Contentful and Sanity, but I am also experienced in the Wordpress.org platform.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I am the web developer for Miami's school newspaper, The Miami Student. The Student is composed of a large staff of students and reaches, on average, 3000 people daily. In 2016, I started designing a new website for the Student that is functional, clean, and aligned with our printed style.

Since the new website's release in January 2017, I've maintained the site and continually added new features to it. I also worked on developing an iOS application in xCode for users to read articles from the Student. Think of it as a New York Times-style app, where all the news a person needs is at their fingertips.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: At Epic, I owned a meaningful and challenging project to help shape the future of healthcare. I understood users' needs, designed, developed, tested, and wrote documentation while collaborating with fellow interns.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Worked as a FileMaker database developer, improving the efficiency and brand of our company's customers by creating custom databases for companies looking for an efficient way of tracking customers and business orders.

I also have done digital marketing and web design, where I've developed websites for businesses and helped with their advertising on social media.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: As a software developer intern for Union Home Mortgage, I worked with a team of 12 developers and 2 other interns. I developed several smaller custom applications to solve business needs on various platforms. One of the bigger projects I worked on was redesigning the company's customer-facing website. I worked closely with a front end developer to design mockups in Adobe XD and build pages in HTML, CSS, and React. We also developed a design system with a library of reusable components to help improve front end development time not only on the website, but also on other applications being created.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I worked directly with the founder and UI/UX designer to implement designed mockups on the company's customer-facing website. This included implementation of a new landing page, Buy Now, and About pages. I actively engaged in learning the Shopify e-commerce platform that the website was hosted on.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Teras Media specializes in custom websites for individuals, small businesses, and enterprise. My responsibilities at the company included design and development of these custom websites.

positions.title: Caddie
positions.description:
Job duties: Carry golfers' bag, replace divots, spot balls, tend flag, and anything else the golfer(s) need.

Skills acquired: Working, communication, and social skills, consideration, patience and a keen eye for golf.

honors.title: Grace Hopper Scholar
honors.description: I was selected out of a handful of students to attend the 2018 Grace Hopper Conference.
honors.issuer: Issued by Department of Interactive Media Studies · Jun 2018

volunteerExperiences.description:
I traveled to Guatemala with fourteen other Miami University engineering students. We partnered with a local organization called Solucíones Comunitarias to solve humanitarian engineering problems in impoverished regions in Guatemala. While there, I surveyed and communicated in Spanish with community members and developed a needs-based analysis application that has since benefited the organization in numerous ways.

We were provided with the knowledge, skills and support necessary to empower marginalized individuals, families and communities. I gained invaluable leadership and professional development experience through foundational training on social entrepreneurship and community consulting, working on high-impact social innovation projects and experiencing deep cultural immersion in local communities.

I volunteered for Miami University's chapter of Engineers without Borders USA. In 2017, I served as the chapter's marketing and social chair. With this role, I designed event flyers and promotional material, increased social media engagement, and planned social events like “EWBoard Games” every other week for members of our organization.

I also spent a lot of time focused on a local project with Miami's Institute for Food. I helped engineer and implement a movable greenhouse for the farm. I also was on the grant writing committee and wrote several grants to help raise money for the work and travel our members do.

projects.title: PennOhio Database
projects.description: This is a database I assisted in designing for a company that does waste disposal. They use it daily to track customers, business orders, and more.

projects.title: Labpacks Unlimited Inc.
projects.description: I completely renovated the online website of Labpacks Unlimited, a company that offers a wide variety of environmental services.

We were provided with the knowledge, skills and support necessary to empower marginalized individuals, families and communities.
